# LeatherCulture

> LeatherCulture is a Pakistani leather brand selling genuine leather jackets, coats, hoodies, shirts and
> trousers for men and women. Every piece is cut and finished by hand in Pakistan. Orders are paid
> cash on delivery and arrive anywhere in Pakistan in 3-5 working days.

## Key facts
- Country: Pakistan. Ships nationwide.
- Payment: cash on delivery only.
- Delivery: Rs 250, free over Rs 10,000. 3-5 working days.
- Exchanges: within 7 days of delivery, unworn with tags.
- Price range: Rs 3,400 to Rs 24,900.
- Currency: PKR.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.leatherculture.shop/): brand overview, best sellers and FAQ.
- [Shop](https://www.leatherculture.shop/shop): the full collection.
- [About](https://www.leatherculture.shop/about): who makes the clothes and how.
- [Journal](https://www.leatherculture.shop/blog): leather care and styling guides.
- [Contact](https://www.leatherculture.shop/contact): sizing help and order support.
